async function createUser({ username, password, fullName, org }) {
    await ensureUsersTable();
    const name = String(username || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!/^[a-z0-9._-]{3,32}$/.test(name)) throw new Error('User name: 3-32 letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore');
    if (String(password || '').length < 8) throw new Error('Password must be at least 8 characters');
    if (!ORGS[org]) throw new Error('Choose your organization');

        name
    ]);

}
async function authenticate(username, password) {
    await ensureUsersTable();
    const rows = await (0, __TURBOPACK__imported__module__$5b$project$5d2f$lib$2f$db$2e$js__$5b$app$2d$route$5d$__$28$ecmascript$29$__["query"])('SELECT username, full_name, org, password_hash FROM app_users WHERE username = $1', [
        String(username || '').trim().toLowerCase()

    if (!user || !checkPassword(String(password || ''), user.password_hash)) return null;

        full_name: user.full_name,
        org: user.org
    };
